title: Add the two missing chat page-purpose translation keys
recorded_defect: packages/views/locales/parity.test.ts fails: en/chat.json defines page.purpose_primary and page.purpose_handoff, but ja, ko and zh-Hans do not. The parity test exists precisely to catch a new EN key landing without a translated key, which would silently fall back to English in production.
objective: The locale bundle parity test in packages/views is failing. packages/views/locales/en/chat.json defines two keys under "page" - purpose_primary and purpose_handoff - which are missing from packages/views/locales/ja/chat.json, packages/views/locales/ko/chat.json and packages/views/locales/zh-Hans/chat.json. Add an accurate translation of each key to each of those three files, matching the tone and terminology already used in that file's other entries. Add nothing else: do not touch the English bundle, any other namespace, or any test. Keep each file's existing key order and JSON formatting.
verification_note: Scoped to the chat namespace with -t so the command matches the task exactly. The inbox namespace has a separate, larger parity gap (180 keys) that this task does not touch.
